analysis.summary: A registered report studying fuzz blockers -- the obstacles that make coverage-guided greybox fuzzers plateau, which benchmarks show typically happens after around 12 hours. Using the FuzzIntrospector platform the authors analyse and categorise these blockers, finding that most top blockers are not directly related to the program input, which points to fuzz driver generation as the area needing better techniques.
